runs.rank_formula: 2 * unique linked seeds + topic-word overlap; descending; stable ties; first 40

D5_equivalent_utf8.comparison: Identical parsed object, UTF-8 JSON indent=2 versus separators=(',', ':'); no final newline
D5_equivalent_utf8.limitation: Serialization whitespace only; not CLI compact/full savings, tokens or scientific equivalence. Cached pages are historical captures, not re-extracted or verified against PDFs here.

D7_last_author_notes.normalization: NFKD ASCII transliteration, casefold, remove non-alphanumeric characters
D7_last_author_notes.filename_key_rule: leading alphabetic token immediately before a four-digit year

limitations: Provider response captures absent from the evidence root cannot be reconstructed offline.
Candidate records, QA counts, and file metadata do not establish scientific relevance or answer completeness.
D5 equivalent UTF-8 comparison preserves all fields and measures only JSON whitespace; answer/report sizes are not comparable content.
D7 uses DOI-matched recorded author strings and an explicit syntactic surname heuristic, not independently validated personal names.
